subject: Cypress - Security evidence sprint & MAP draft
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery.johnson@redwood.com>
To: Dana Lee <dana.lee@cypress.com>, Michael O'Neill <m.oneill@cypress.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Mar 2027 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Cypress - Security evidence sprint & MAP draft

Hi Dana / Michael — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick post-call recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the MAP milestone for security / SOC 2 evidence delivery.

Call highlights (summary):
- Goal: get Cypress through our security gate so we can sign the Dedicated capacity agreement and hit target start date in April.
- Primary blockers discussed: completed SOC 2 questionnaire, evidence of log retention + change control, signed DPA / PO.

Proposed MAP milestones (draft):
1) Security questionnaire completed (you) — deliverable: filled questionnaire XLSX (we can accept draft answers) — target: 2027-03-19
2) Evidence index + artifacts upload (owners below) — deliverable: EvidenceIndex_Template.csv with links to artifacts — target: 2027-03-24
3) Internal review & clarifications (Redwood security) — deliverable: questions/confirmations back to Cypress — target: 2027-03-26
4) SOC 2 package handoff (final bundle for your auditors) — deliverable: zipped evidence + narratives — target: 2027-03-29

Responsibilities (suggested):
- Cypress: questionnaire answers, permissions for log samples, legal countersign PO/DPA
- Redwood: compile control narratives (Marissa), collect infra and logs (Ben), produce evidence index (Avery)

Dependencies / risks:
- Legal / procurement timing (PO) could push the close beyond 3/29 if authorization windows are missed.
- A few artifacts (SLA monitoring dashboards, long-term log retention exports) may require a short engineering pull from your side.

Attachments: I attached a blank EvidenceIndex_Template and the SOC 2 questionnaire for your team to fill.

Ask: Please confirm owners and whether the proposed due dates (19/24/26/29 Mar) work for your audit cadence. If they do, I’ll convert this into a one-page MAP and send via DocuSign for signature and link it to the HubSpot deal.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this over the finish line.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
avery.johnson@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0183

Thanks Avery — this is helpful and aligns with our internal timeline. I'm attaching our draft responses to the SOC 2 questionnaire (Cypress_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx). A few quick notes:

- We'll own the questionnaire answers (I'll be the point). Expect a first pass back by end of day 2027-03-18 (we're aiming 3/19 but I'll try to accelerate).
- For log retention evidence: can you confirm the format you need (S3 links, short export CSVs, or screenshots of retention policies)?
- Procurement: PO is in flight but our legal lead needs the DPA redline reviewed before we can finalize. Is there an internal Redwood contact for legal to loop in?

Also: our internal audit team asked whether the MAP could reflect a hard buffer for their review — would +3 business days after your internal review (item 3) be reasonable?

Attaching: Cypress_SOC2_Questionnaire_v1.xlsx (attachment stub).

Date: Tue, 16 Mar 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Cypress - Security evidence sprint & MAP draft (internal owners)

Avery / Ben — adding internal owners and a proposed internal cadence.

I reviewed the questionnaire attachment Dana sent. We should be able to meet the dates with the following owners:

- Marissa Cole (security narratives & control mapping): will draft the narratives for SOC 2 controls and review questionnaire answers — deliverable by 2027-03-25
- Ben Carter (infra evidence & logs): will extract log retention exports and screenshots of monitoring dashboards; deliverable by 2027-03-24
- Avery (deal owner / evidence index): I can hand off artifacts to you for packaging and creation of the final bundle — deliverable by 2027-03-28

Notes on evidence format (please share with Cypress):
- Preferred: direct S3 links with read-only tokens or a zipped export (CSV/JSON) for logs. Screenshots acceptable for dashboards but audits prefer raw exports where feasible.
- Please include timestamps and retention policy docs for any log exports.
- For change control: a single consolidated PDF of recent change tickets (last 12 months) plus the policy doc is sufficient.

I've attached a short security snapshot and the EvidenceIndex_Template to make it easy for Cypress to drop links/notes. Once Dana confirms the log format, Ben and I can schedule a quick 30-min upload session to accept artifacts into a secure share (we can provide a temporary S3 bucket or a secure Drive folder).

One operational ask: if Cypress adds the +3 business day buffer for internal audit review we should capture that in the MAP to avoid scope creep; it will shift the SOC 2 package handoff to 2027-04-01 in that scenario.

Marissa Cole
Security Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference

Dana / Michael — great, thanks for the fast turnaround and for owning the questionnaire. Confirming the plan below and next steps. Per Marissa, we're flexible to add a +3 business day buffer if Cypress audit requires it — I noted both target dates below.

Confirmed MAP (dates):
- 2027-03-19: Cypress first-pass questionnaire (Dana) [if delayed -> 2027-03-20 backup]
- 2027-03-24: Evidence index + artifacts (Ben / Cypress owners)
- 2027-03-26: Redwood internal review (Marissa) [+3 business day buffer => 2027-03-31]
- 2027-03-29: SOC 2 package handoff (Avery) [if buffer used -> 2027-04-01]

Immediate asks / blockers for Cypress: please confirm preferred evidence transfer method (S3 link vs zipped upload) and the legal contact for DPA redlines so we can loop our counsel in. If you can reply with that info by 2027-03-17, we'll keep the March MAP intact.

I'll convert this into a one-page MAP and route via DocuSign once you confirm owners + evidence transfer approach. Linking the HubSpot deal and DocuSign when complete.

Next short steps:
- Dana: return questionnaire (by 3/19) + confirm transfer method + legal POC
- Ben: ready to schedule upload session once transfer method confirmed
- Marissa: will begin narrative drafts on 3/22 and will reserve 2 days for follow-ups
- Avery: will produce the MAP PDF and route for signature after Dana confirms

Thanks again — ping me on Slack or reply-all if anything needs shifting.

Best,
